response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep systems thinking, and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks clear evidence of distributed systems ownership at scale, Python mastery, or direct experience with AI-native code production as a baseline — his work with DLang and Node.js is impressive but doesn't fully align with the role's core technical demands.
strengths: Proven experience in AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq
Extensive background in high-throughput systems and low-latency services
Strong operational and open-source contributions with CI/CD and DevOps practices
concerns: No clear demonstration of Python mastery — primary languages are TypeScript and DLang
Lacks explicit experience with agentic code generation as a daily workflow baseline
Limited evidence of leading technical strategy or owning high-reliability distributed systems at staff level
